{{Top|leg}}
A '''Ship's Operating License''' was a certification issued by the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]]. It tracked the ship's make, manufacturer, port of origin, [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder code]], and owner of the ship. It cost 1000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to receive.

To get one for a ship, it required the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to have a [[Captain's Accredited License/Legends|Captain's Accredited License]] and the ship had to pass an inspection.
